csv_scope_of_work: DCAMM is an agency within the Executive Office for Administration and Finance (ANF) responsible for capital planning, major public building construction, facilities management, and real estate services for the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The initial scope of the Wellness Center Addition involves the study, design and construction of an approximately 17,000 to 20,000 gross square foot addition to the existing Clean Harbors Athletic Center at the Academy. A future phase will provide comprehensive renovations and upgrades to the existing Clean Harbors Athletic Center. These future improvements are anticipated to include major building systems upgrades, programmatic reconfiguration, accessibility improvements, and modernization of interior and exterior spaces. Implementation of the subsequent phase will be contingent upon the availability of future funding. Please refer to the Mass Maritime Academy Wellness Center Feasibility Study in the supporting documentation section for more information.
